name: Grappling Hook
summary: Utilize: throw it at a catch within 50 ft; it holds on a DC 13 Dexterity (Acrobatics) check.
text: As a Utilize action, you throw the hook at a railing, ledge, or other catch within 50 feet of you; it catches if you succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity (Acrobatics) check. If a Rope is tied to it, you can then climb the Rope.
